title: Notice how appetite grows
summary: This meets the excuse that craving is harmless because it feels natural. The line begins at the first attachment and starts tracing how appetite learns to rule.
takeaway: Catch craving while it is still small.
lifeApplication: Before indulging the next impulse, ask what this wanting first felt like in the body: milk, comfort, attention, relief. Name the pattern early enough to interrupt it.

source.shortMeaning: Greed becomes clearer when its early growth is honestly named.
source.lifeApplication: When craving rises, trace it back early enough to keep it from maturing.

evidence.coreClaim: Greed becomes clearer when its early growth is honestly named.
evidence.turn: Greed becomes easier to face when its growth is named.
